entities.name: Utvara Valley
entities.description: A harsh barony outside the main city of Ravnica, ruled by Teysa Karlov, with an Orzhov-owned settlement and Gruul-controlled wilderness.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The guild-ruled plane and city beside which Utvara lies.

entities.name: Teysa Karlov
entities.description: Baroness of Utvara who was manipulated into unknowingly assassinating her ancestor, later uncovered the truth and rallied guild elements against Hauc.

entities.name: Orzhov Syndicate
entities.description: A Ravnican guild that owns the Utvara settlement and leased the site to the Izzet.

entities.name: Izzet League
entities.description: A Ravnican guild that ran experiments in Utvara and built the Cauldron.

entities.name: Gruul Clans
entities.description: Clans who control most of the Utvara wilderness and claim both Utvara and the Rubblebelt.

entities.name: Selesnya Conclave
entities.description: A guild that established a presence in Utvara through Vitar Yescu.

entities.name: Rubblebelt
entities.description: A region abutting Utvara and claimed by the Gruul.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: A dragon whose ancient hunting grounds included Utvara and who destroyed two of the Nephilim.

entities.name: Zomaj Hauc
entities.description: An Izzet magelord who ordered the sterilizing bomb and planned to awaken dragons to control them.

entities.name: Kaluzax
entities.description: A goblin observer who deployed the prototype bomb that created the Schism.

entities.name: The Schism
entities.description: A warped rift in the sky that drained life from Utvara and trapped the spirits of the dead.

entities.name: Vitar Yescu
entities.description: A twelve-story tree whose pollen protected the township from the kuga plague; it was burned to ashes.

entities.name: The Cauldron
entities.description: A steamworks complex the Izzet built into the Utvara Flats, site of the final battle.

entities.name: Uncle
entities.description: An Orzhov figure who orchestrated his own death to ascend to the Ghost Council.

entities.name: Melisk
entities.description: The secret ally used by Uncle to manipulate Teysa Karlov.

entities.name: Ghost Council
entities.description: The Orzhov ruling body that Uncle sought to join.

entities.name: Nephilim
entities.description: Monsters that grew to immense size feeding on a dragon's flesh and trampled the valley.

entities.name: Crixizix
entities.description: Led the town's reconstruction efforts.

entities.name: Domri Rade
entities.description: A Gruul planeswalker whose spark ignited during the Burying in Utvara, sending him to Alara.

entities.name: The Burying
entities.description: A coming-of-age ceremony all Gruul undergo.

entities.name: Alara
entities.description: The plane Domri Rade was sent to when his spark ignited.

entities.name: Guildpact
entities.description: The magical contract that forbade unclaimed settlement.

events.summary: Utvara is devastated by a Simic-origin plague worsened by Gruul encroachment and is declared a reclamation zone.
events.quote: Utvara was devastated by a Simic -origin plague.

events.summary: Kaluzax deploys a prototype bomb on Hauc's orders; instead of exploding it forms the Schism, draining life and trapping spirits.
events.quote: Instead of exploding, the device formed a warped rift in the sky

events.summary: A scavenger uncovers a buried city, sparking illegal prospecting financed by the Orzhov and an unlawful shantytown.
events.quote: a scavenger uncovered a vast buried city beneath the brickwork

events.summary: The Izzet return after discovering three unhatched dragon eggs and build the Cauldron.
events.quote: the Izzet established the Cauldron , a massive steamworks complex built into the Utvara Flats

events.summary: Uncle orchestrates his own death through Melisk, who manipulates Teysa into unknowingly assassinating him; Teysa later uncovers the truth.
events.quote: Uncle" orchestrated his death to ascend to the Ghost Council

events.summary: Teysa rallies local guild elements to halt Hauc's apocalyptic ambitions.
events.quote: Teysa uncovered the truth and rallied local guild elements to halt Hauc’s apocalyptic ambitions.

events.summary: The final battle at the Cauldron destroys it; the three dragons are killed and Vitar Yescu is burned to ashes.
events.quote: The three dragons were killed — one in its egg, the other two in aerial combat.

events.summary: The Nephilim grow huge feeding on a dragon, level the Utvara settlement, and leave for Ravnica City after Niv-Mizzet destroys two of them.
events.quote: The Utvara settlement was leveled, and many were killed.
Crixizix led the town's reconstruction efforts.

events.summary: About 60 years later, Domri Rade performs the Burying in Utvara; the stress ignites his spark and sends him to Alara.
events.quote: The stress of the experience caused his planeswalker spark to ignite, sending him to Alara from inside the sarcophagus he was buried in.
